item.title: 2024 viewing roundup: a few ways of living with fate
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: A personal 2024 viewing roundup that reads Blossoms Shanghai, The Long Season, Only the River Flows, and Journey to the West through the lens of fate, madness, compromise, and reconciliation.
